verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice documents recurring invoices and manually created credit notes. Neither is proration: the pack has no evidence of mid-cycle upgrade or downgrade handling, partial-period calculation, or documented proration math. Proration is a fair axis for a billing and invoicing product, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a finance lead, mid-cycle upgrades and downgrades are prorated with documented, auditable math — credits, partial periods, and invoice line items that reconcile to the penny
